references.label: Fresh ripe guava

references.label: Fresh ripe sapota
references.caveat: Cultivar and size selection differ; do not use as fixed piece weight.

references.label: Fresh ripe papaya
references.caveat: Ripe fruit; do not silently substitute for green papaya or prepared flesh.

references.label: Whole raw mango
references.caveat: Wild Indian variety; Thai cultivars and ripe fruit require proxy review.
